about: Shows that something is loading, beside words or over the content it replaces. Over content, the loader hides it and keeps its box, so the layout does not shift when the content returns.

button.about: A button loaded and loading. The label is hidden and keeps its width, so the button does not resize when the save starts or ends.
button.title: In a button

ledger: Matched against the ledger, then written back.

palette.about: The spinner in each semantic palette's solid color. Without a palette the spinner takes the ink of the surrounding text.
palette.title: Palettes

placement.about: The spinner before or after its words. Both stay on one line in any container.
placement.title: Placement

scrim.about: The overlay's fill over a card that is loading. `veil` keeps the content visible behind the spinner, `glass` blurs it, and `none` leaves it unchanged.
scrim.title: Scrims

title: Loader

value.about: A value loaded and loading. The spinner is centred over the hidden value, and screen readers read the label `Loading` in its place.
value.title: Over a value
